text: Program Description E-commerce is a new interdisciplinary subject integrating computer science, marketing, management, economics, law and modern logistics. The professional training to master the computer information technology, marketing, international trade, management, law and modern logistics, the basic theory and basic knowledge, has the ability of using the Internet to carry out business activities and the use of computer information technology, modern logistics method to improve the enterprise management, improve the level of enterprise management ability of innovative e-commerce senior specialized talents. Duration 3 years
